title: Campfire cover: an old folk tune, our own bird verses
storyboard: Film: 6–10 campers singing round a campfire with one guitar; wide + 2 close-ups, 3 takes
caption:
A camp-night classic with new words.

In most hornbill species the nest hole is closed with mud while the female is inside, leaving a small opening through which the male passes food.
